meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents...“For A Song,” your perfect Seacrest West retreat! Pet friendly and thoughtfully designed, this inviting home features a private pool and spa, a fenced yard ideal for pets and a screened-in patio perfect for relaxing together. Admire the unique art collection and don’t forget to bring your favorite vinyl for the turntable! Have fun with the ping pong table or grab one of the 6 provided bikes to explore the nearby communities along Scenic Highway 30A. Discover local shops, delicious dining and the vibrant atmosphere of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Everyone is welcome at this coastal escape, paws included! Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private seasonally heated pool and spa with loungers – Relax in your own oasis, perfect for unwinding after a long day or soaking up the sun.Pet Friendly Home with Fenced Yard – Bring your four-legged family members and enjoy a secure outdoor space for play and relaxationScreened-in porch with outdoor dining and fireplace – Enjoy cozy evenings under the stars with a warm fire and al fresco meals, rain or shine.6 bikes included for exploring Scenic Highway 30A and nearby communitiesSpacious backyard with a ping pong table – Gather with family and friends for laughter and friendly competition in your private outdoor retreat.Gourmet kitchen with upgraded appliances – Cook up delicious meals effortlessly in a chef-inspired kitchen with everything you need to impress.Beautiful outsider art collection and music options – Add to the ambiance with unique artwork and play your favorite records on the turntable or stream music via Bluetooth.3 King + 1 Bunk Room, Sleeps 10 – Plenty of room to spread out and create unforgettable memories with your loved ones.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The backyard is the all-star of the property. The screened patio was perfect, and the pool/spa was endless fun for the family." – Jason E.⭐ "The pictures don’t do justice to this beautiful home. The pool and yard were perfect!" – Brenda J.⭐ "Wonderful family vacation! The house was clean and spacious, and the included bikes made exploring so much fun. Highly recommend." – Pete A.*** LIVING AREA ***Enter a bright and welcoming living space bathed in natural sunlight. Wrap-around windows frame stunning views of the lush backyard, creating a seamless connection to the outdoors. A cozy sectional invites relaxation, complemented by a Smart TV for entertainment. Whether you’re curling up by the fireplace or hosting a lively game night, this charming space is perfect for unwinding and making memories.Spacious, open-concept layout with expansive windows flooding the space with natural lightCozy seating area complemented by a Smart TV and a charming fireplaceSeamless access to a beautifully screened-in patio*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, equipped with state-of-the-art appliances and ample counter space for meal preparation. The island offers seating for three, while the nearby dining table accommodates six, making it ideal for everything from casual breakfasts to family dinners.Modern gourmet kitchen fully equipped with premium appliancesStylish island seating for 3, complemented by a dining table for 6Perfect for casual meals or hosting memorable gatherings*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The backyard is nothing short of spectacular and perfect for both guests and pets. Unwind by the private heated pool, soak in the spa, or relax on the screened-in patio with a cozy fireplace. The fenced yard offers peace of mind while your dog enjoys the outdoors. For added fun, enjoy a lively game of ping pong, offering entertainment for all ages!Enjoy a seasonally heated pool and spaRelax on a screened-in patio featuring dining for 6, fireplace with lounge area, and a gas grillHave fun with a ping pong table and a large, fenced yardUnwind on poolside loungers, perfect for soaking up the sun*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***“For A Song” comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. Each bedroom features a Smart TV, while a washer and dryer provide added convenience during your stay.1st Floor:Bunk Room: Twin-over-twin bunk bed, full bed and flat-screen TVKing Guest Bedroom: King bed and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Dual vanities and walk-in shower2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-Suite with dual vanities, soaking tub & walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with farmhouse sink and walk-in shower*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest West, “For A Song” offers a comfortable home base for exploring the east end of Scenic Highway 30A. Enjoy local restaurants and shopping, visit The Big Chill for live music and entertainment or spend an afternoon exploring the beautiful architecture and charming streets of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach.The Big Chill: Restaurants, live music and family-friendly entertainmentAlys Beach: Beautiful white architecture, local dining and scenic green spacesRosemary Beach: Boutique shopping, coffee shops, restaurants and its charming Town CenterScenic Highway 30A Bike Path: Explore Seacrest and surrounding communities using the provided bikes*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyMaximum weight of 30 lbsPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Pool heating available September 1–April 30.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 53326STRO #: STR-053326 Read less
